title: proof purge --kind
body:
### Summary

As a human, I want `aayu proof purge --kind recording`, so that I can purge one kind by hand.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: `aayu proof purge --kind recording --dry-run` on the fixture ledger; expected: only recordings are listed for purge

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 1 criteria

### Scenario

Run the command with --dry-run against the fixture ledger.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

### Links

depends-on #42
